lines: +- Digital-worker (MAIB) outbound auth now uses the M365 Agents SDK's native `IdentityProxyManager` connection auth type instead of a custom MSAL monkeypatch (`_apply_msal_patches`), which previously overrode `MsalAuth.get_agentic_application_token` to perform the federated-identity (FMI) token exchange. The M365 SDK performs that exchange natively from `1.1.0`.

+- Raised the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK dependency floors to `>=1.1.0` (`microsoft-agents-hosting-core`, `microsoft-agents-authentication-msal`, `microsoft-agents-activity`): the `IdentityProxyManager` connection auth type is only available from `1.1.0`.
+- Removed the `azure-identity` runtime dependency: it was only used by the now-removed MSAL patch.
